verdict.rationale: Exporting account data is a fair question for a SaaS conversion service, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no way to export all account data (job history, settings, stored files) in open formats. Exporting converted files back to S3 is just the per-job output step, not a data export. 'Cancel anytime, no minimum term' covers leaving but not taking your data with you. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.
